title: Louis XIV dies after a 72-year reign
summary: Louis XIV, the Sun King, died at Versailles of gangrene, leaving the throne to his five-year-old great-grandson Louis XV.
reason: His long reign had outlived his son and grandson, so the crown passed to a child under a regency.
significance: His reign, the longest of any European monarch, defined absolute monarchy, but left France deep in debt.
